news.title: AWANTEC Wins RM8.68mil Sage X3 ERP Contract from TH Plantations
Awantec secures RM8.7m ERP contract from TH Plantations

recent_en: AWANTEC recently secured an RM8.68 million Sage X3 ERP contract from TH Plantations, while substantial shareholder LEMBAGA TABUNG AMANAH WARISAN NEGERI TERENGGANU filed multiple changes in shareholding between September and November.
notable_en: Secured an RM8.68 million Sage X3 ERP contract from TH Plantations.
Substantial shareholder LEMBAGA TABUNG AMANAH WARISAN NEGERI TERENGGANU filed multiple changes in shareholding between September and November.
